name: San Francisco Center for the Book (SFCB)

facts.text: A nonprofit founded in 1996 by Mary Austin and Kathleen Burch.
Offers classes in bookbinding, letterpress printing, artist's books and calligraphy.

name: San Francisco Children's Art Center
note: No address given; located at Fort Mason Center, 2 Marina Blvd, Building C

facts.text: A nonprofit that has operated at Fort Mason Center since 1978.
Teaches art to children ages 2 to 10 and runs artist residencies in schools.

name: San Francisco Fire Department Pioneer Museum

facts.text: Exhibits cover the history of the city's fire, police, sheriff and EMS departments.
The society was founded in 1988 by historian Charles A. Fracchia.

name: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art

facts.text: Reopened May 14, 2016, after a three-year closure for an expansion.

name: San Francisco Sea Scout Base

facts.text: The U.S. Army built the base in World War II as a landing craft maintenance facility.
The Army gave the keys to the Sea Scouts in 1947.

name: Serge Sorokko Gallery
